resources.string: Not working yet: virtual machines can\'t be created from here. The switch is kept for apps that look for it.
Not working yet: handing off between devices isn\'t available. The switch is kept for apps that look for it.
Not working yet: AI tasks are not moved to the NPU, and apps are told so.
Pretends to apps that /system is writable; nothing is actually remounted. Only has an effect while SU Bridge is on. Shown here because it is on, or because Developer options are unlocked.
Tells apps a kernel module loaded when nothing was loaded. Only has an effect while SU Bridge is on.
Tells flashing and backup apps a partition write worked when nothing was written. Only has an effect while SU Bridge is on.
Swallows reboot and soft-reboot requests from apps: they are told it worked and nothing restarts. Only has an effect while SU Bridge is on.
